YOU ARE THE MONSTER. Five levels of armed hunters. Kill them all. You run on BLOOD: it drains constantly, kills refill it, and slashing a corpse once gives an extra sip. Run dry and you starve.

STAY OUT OF THE LIGHT  they only see you inside the cone in front of them. Pale = calm, yellow = suspicious, red = shooting. They fire every 2 seconds; 3 hits and you're dead.

MOVE  like Gorilla Tag: slap and push off the ground, walls and trees with your hands to bound along; let go mid-push to leap. Hold the trigger (or grip) to grab whatever your hand is touching and pull yourself along or climb; let go and you're released instantly.  TURN  right thumbstick.

KILL  swipe through them (far more damage if they haven't seen you). Grip a limb and yank to rip it off. Grip the body to lift them and twist your wrist to turn them. Dead bodies are ragdolls you can drag, throw and tear apart. RIP IN HALF  grab the top half with one hand and the legs/hips with the other, then pull your arms apart.

ROAR  press X: every hunter nearby hears it and comes to look where you roared, without seeing you. Roar, then slip round behind them.

LEVELS  the woods give way to a hunting camp, a logging camp, a fenced outpost, and finally a military encampment. Levels 4 and 5 have CAMERAS: if one spots you it sounds an alarm and every hunter nearby comes for you. Slash a camera to wreck it. On level 5, kill the guarded DEER in the middle of the camp, then escape to the edge of the map.

CALIBRATE  the first time you enter VR: stand up straight, then hold your arms out wide. Your claws sit exactly where your controllers are and only stretch when you straighten your arm all the way. Re-do it any time at the purple button on the lobby's right wall; REACH − / + sets how far a straight arm stretches (1.00 = no stretch).

YOUR OWN SOUNDS  put a folder called sounds next to index.html with files named slash1.mp3, slash2.mp3… (claw swings) and hit1.mp3… (claws connecting), roar1.mp3… (your scream on X). Also works for hunter voices: scream1.mp3, shout1.mp3, pain1.mp3, death1.mp3. .m4a, .wav and .ogg work too. Only when played from your website, not from a file on your computer.

LOBBY  punch the arrows to pick a level, punch START.

Desktop test: WASD + mouse, click = swipe, hold E / Q = grab, click while holding = yank, release = throw, F = roar.
